EXTERNAL FINAL EVALUATION
MdM Consortium Capacity Building and Deployment
Project– EU Aid Volunteers

Publication of the Terms of Reference for the final external evaluations of two projects
implemented by Médicos del Mundo within the EU Aid Volunteers initiative.

(1) Terms of reference for the Evaluation: MdM Consortium Capacity Building Project– EU
Aid Volunteers

• Budget: maximum 10.000 € (VAT included)

(2) Terms of reference for the Evaluation: MdM Consortium Deployment Project – EU Aid
Volunteers

• Budget: maximum 10.000 € (VAT included)

A separate evaluation proposal will be submitted for each project.

The intention in publishing the Terms of Reference of the two evaluations simultaneously is to
award their execution to the same person or organization.

The deadline for submission of applications will be 22 November 2019 to the following email
address: ramon.esteso@medicosdelmundo.org and evaluacion@medicosdelmundo.org

Terms of Reference

1. Background and Context
MdM Spain together with its European partners (MdM Netherlands, MdM Sweden, MdM
Belgium and MdM UK) has responded as a Consortium to the EU Aid Volunteers Initiative Call
of the European Union.
1.1 Presentation and Objectives of EU Aid Volunteers Initiative
- Complement current humanitarian interventions with the deployment of volunteers
with a view to supporting local organizations to deliver needs-based humanitarian aid,
while also building the capacity and resilience of local communities affected by
disasters globally.
- Strengthen capacities of sending and hosting organizations participating or planning to
participate in the EU Aid Volunteers Initiative.
Moreover, as MdM participates as a Consortium in the Capacity Building in the framework of
the EU Aid Volunteers Initiative, it is necessary to implement the mentioned project, following
the 3 main EU Regulations:
1. Regulation Nº 375/2014: establishes the European Voluntary Humanitarian Aid Corps
(= “EU Aid Volunteers Initiative”)
2. Implementing Regulation Nº 1244/2014: establishes volunteer management
procedures, training programme, certification mechanism
3. Delegated Regulation Nº 1398/2014: establishes standards on recognition, equal
opportunities, partnerships and the competence framework
